35 kV step-up parameter example

The 35 kV step-up example connects wind, photovoltaic and energy-storage systems to the collection network. Select the capacity, voltage ratio and impedance to match the project.

Mainstream products reach the national secondary energy-efficiency standard (S20 series): no-load loss 20–30% lower than the traditional S13 type and load loss 10–15% lower.

Design and performance

Functional features

High efficiency
Cold-rolled silicon steel with 45° full-mitre joints and amorphous-alloy options; no-load loss reduced by more than 30%.
Sealed tank
Fully sealed corrugated oil tank prevents leakage and suits harsh outdoor environments.
Short-circuit strength
Body structure designed to withstand sudden short-circuit impact.
Intelligent O&M
Remote monitoring with telesignalling, telemetry, teleregulation and telecontrol.
Maintenance-free
Suspended-core-free design reduces maintenance cost.
Aluminium core option
Aluminium-core design for new-energy projects reduces life-cycle carbon emissions.

Product advantages

Foil-wound LV coils
Whole series uses low-voltage copper-foil winding for short-circuit resistance well above industry level.
Lower lead resistance
Insulating LV clamps reduce lead resistance in oil by 10–15%; load loss 1–3% below the industry advanced level.
Standardised design
Step-by-step standardised design for rapid design, production and delivery.
Anti-corrosion
Acid washing, phosphating and three-proof paint; anti-corrosion up to C5-H.

Application scope

  • PowerDistribution network upgrades, civil power supply, substations, renewable-energy grid connection.
  • IndustryFactory distribution rooms and large power-equipment supply.
  • TransportationPublic infrastructure, electric traction and lighting supply.
  • ConstructionCommercial plazas, communication buildings, residential areas, temporary supply.
  • Power generationLarge motors, circulating water pumps, induced-draft fans and other auxiliaries.
